Elegant contained tapered wake, no neon scribble mess. Each cell isolated with at least 15% transparent perimeter, equal camera scale and same effect origin at 75% cell width /55% cell height.

Every frame must have a genuinely different painted silhouette/topology. Transparent RGBA, preserve semitransparent light. No flat colored background.
